title_ar: درء تعارض العقل والنقل أو موافقة صحيح المنقول لصريح المعقول
title_es_or_en: Dar' ta'arud al-'aql wa-l-naql (Averting the conflict between reason and transmission)
genre: kalam / epistemology treatise (refutation of kalam and philosophy)
edition_note: Edition named in OpenITI header: ed. 'Abd al-Latif 'Abd al-Rahman, Dar al-Kutub al-'Ilmiyya, Beirut 1417/1997, 10 vols. Header says Shamela pagination matches the print ('ترقيم الشاملة موافق للمطبوع'). Page numbers are from OpenITI PageV markers; I did not check page images.
notes: Whole work is by Ibn Taymiyya, but it quotes and summarises Razi, Ghazali, Juwayni, Ibn al-'Arabi, Ibn Sina and others at length. Vol. 1 pp. 3-6 is the opening where he describes and criticises the 'rule' of the theologians. Passages quoted here are marked by stance; quotations of Razi are summaries, not verbatim quotations.

edition_note: Majma' al-Malik Fahd edition, ed. 'Abd al-Rahman b. Muhammad b. Qasim (per OpenITI header; header says pagination matches the print). Page numbers from OpenITI PageV markers.
notes: Compilation, not a single work; the vol. 16 passage (T3-12, T3-13) is inside a commentary on Surah al-'Alaq (96), inferred from the text, section heading not checked. Vol. 16 also contains related remarks on the first obligation.

genre: polemical refutation of Shi'i (Rafidi) and Qadari-Mu'tazili positions
edition_note: OpenITI text from Shamela al-Zaydiyya (header: bkid 108, 'al-Maktaba al-Shamela al-Zaydiyya'). Printed edition not named in header. Inline page markers such as '(1/302)' and '(1/303)' appear in the text and agree with the OpenITI PageV markers used here. Page to be checked against a print edition before citing.
notes: The passage (T3-14) is part of the discussion of the Jahmi/Mu'tazili proof of createdness via accidents; Ibn Taymiyya mentions the Ash'ari dispute on the same method.

title_ar: قاعدة جامعة في توحيد الله وإخلاص الوجه والعمل له عبادة واستعانة
title_es_or_en: Qa'ida jami'a fi tawhid Allah (comprehensive principle on the oneness of God)
edition_note: OpenITI text from Shamela (header: publisher Dar al-'Asima, Riyadh; editor not recorded in the header). Page numbers are OpenITI PageV markers (single volume).
notes: WARNING: the Shamela text contains an unrelated insertion right after T3-15 (a passage titled on 'ilat al-shar'i' / usul al-fiqh). Check the page image before quoting T3-15.
